name: Melemele Island
description: The sun-drenched first island of the Alola region, home to Iki Town, the bustling streets of Hau'oli City, and the flower-filled Melemele Meadow.

name: Akala Island
description: The lush middle island, spanning the Paniola ranch lands, the flowing pools of Brooklet Hill, the smoking Wela Volcano, and the humid Lush Jungle.

name: Ula'ula Island
description: The largest island, from the arid Haina Desert and the stargazing slopes of Mount Hokulani to quiet Tapu Village and Malie Garden.

name: Poni Island
description: The wild, sparsely settled final island, home to the untamed Poni Wilds, the towering Vast Poni Canyon, and the windswept Poni Meadow.
